module_summary: AXI read DMA: an address FSM splits descriptors into 4K-safe AXI bursts, a read FSM shifts/aligns returned data and pushes it through a 32-entry output FIFO onto an AXI stream, then reports status.

anchors.name: axi_state_reg
anchors.why: Address FSM: IDLE accepts descriptor, START issues AXI AR bursts until length exhausted.

anchors.name: axis_state_reg
anchors.why: Read-data FSM: IDLE takes internal command, READ moves AXI R beats to stream and status.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor valid; with ready it loads address, length, tag into command registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_ready
anchors.why: Descriptor ready, asserted in idle when enabled and no pending command.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor start address loaded into addr_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_len
anchors.why: Descriptor byte length loaded into op_word_count and cycle counts.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle status pulse when the last output cycle of a descriptor completes.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_error
anchors.why: Error code derived from accumulated AXI read response.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_tag
anchors.why: Echoes descriptor tag with status.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid; START state waits for it low before issuing next burst.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI address ready clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst start address driven from addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length computed from per-burst word count.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-data valid; with rready advances read counters and output.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read-data ready, gated by output FIFO space and input_active.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data, saved and shifted to form stream data.

anchors.name: m_axi_rresp
anchors.why: Read response captured on SLVERR/DECERR for status error.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data read from output FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from FIFO output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready pops output FIFO into output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tlast
anchors.why: Marks last beat of descriptor frame.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep, trimmed on last cycle by last_cycle_offset.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables accepting new descriptors.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current read address, advanced by each burst size; checks 4K boundary.

anchors.name: op_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of descriptor; decremented per burst, decides more bursts.

anchors.name: tr_word_count_next
anchors.why: Per-burst byte count limited by max burst and 4K boundary; sets arlen.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Internal command valid handing descriptor parameters from address FSM to read FSM.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Read FSM accepts internal command, clearing axis_cmd_valid.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Command register bank holding cycle counts, offsets, tag for read FSM.

anchors.name: input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining AXI input beats; ends input_active.

anchors.name: output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining output stream cycles; sets output_last_cycle.

anchors.name: input_active_reg
anchors.why: More AXI input beats expected; gates rready and counter updates.

anchors.name: output_active_reg
anchors.why: More output cycles pending; gates output counter decrement.

anchors.name: output_last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last output cycle: sets tlast, trims tkeep, emits status, returns to idle.

anchors.name: bubble_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Unaligned bubble cycle flag; disabled when ENABLE_UNALIGNED=0.

anchors.name: first_cycle_reg
anchors.why: First beat of transfer, used for unaligned bubble handling.

anchors.name: offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte offset selecting shift amount for read data alignment.

anchors.name: last_cycle_offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte count of final cycle used to trim tkeep.

anchors.name: rresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky AXI error response accumulated across the transfer.

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Descriptor tag held for status output.

anchors.name: save_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Previous AXI read beat saved for cross-beat shifting.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for save_axi_rdata_reg on accepted beat.

anchors.name: shift_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Aligned read data from current and saved beats shifted by offset.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal stream valid; write enable into output FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from FIFO not half full; throttles rready.

anchors.name: out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: 32-entry output FIFO data array buffering stream beats.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer, increments on internal valid when not full.

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer, increments when output register loads.

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: FIFO half-full flag backpressures internal ready.

anchors.name: out_fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full blocks writes.

anchors.name: out_fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty blocks output register load.

groups.name: AXI address controller
groups.description: Accepts descriptors and issues 4K-safe AXI read bursts, tracking address and remaining length.

groups.name: Internal command register
groups.description: Holds per-descriptor offsets, cycle counts and tag passed from address FSM to read FSM.

groups.name: Read data controller
groups.description: Sequences AXI R beats, counts input/output cycles, generates tlast and descriptor status.

groups.name: Read data alignment
groups.description: Shifts AXI read data by byte offset and forms internal stream beats with tkeep/tlast.

groups.name: Output FIFO
groups.description: 32-entry stream FIFO with output register driving the AXI stream master.
